solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cry during 'Billy Elliot'

indicators.note: during says the answer sits inside the run of the film title's letters

explanation.surface: Someone sobs or shouts while watching the musical film about a boy ballet dancer.
explanation.definitionFit: To shout loudly is to cry out, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Where US-style greeting irks her badly?

parts.note: yo is an American slang greeting

indicators.note: badly says the letters of the two words beside it are scrambled

explanation.surface: A place where an American hello gets on a woman's nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where' alone defines, with the question mark: Yorkshire is a northern English county famed for blunt speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A large county in northern England is a place, answering the question where.

clue.text: Spoils exotic allure by beginning to swear

indicators.note: exotic means strange or foreign, so the letters take an unusual order
beginning to picks the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone ruins foreign charm by starting to curse.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurels are honours or rewards won, the spoils of victory.

clue.text: Retired performer in demand

parts.note: ex means former, as of someone who has retired
an act is a performer or troupe on a bill

explanation.surface: A performer who has left the stage is still sought after.
explanation.definitionFit: To exact is to demand payment or obedience, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Simple furniture?

parts.note: a piece of furniture that is easy, comfortable to relax in, read as if it were plain

explanation.surface: Some basic, plain furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A comfortable upholstered armchair for relaxing in.

clue.text: What are the odds of army over brave unsophisticated beings?

indicators.note: the odds of means the odd-numbered letters, first, third, fifth and so on, through these words

explanation.surface: A question about the chances of soldiers beating courageous simple creatures.
explanation.walkthrough: The odd letters run on across all three words: A, M, O, E, B, A, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Amoebae are single-celled organisms, among the simplest of living things.

clue.text: Uncontrolled lust overcoming a place in Oklahoma

indicators.note: in a down clue overcoming means placed above the next piece
uncontrolled means running wild, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Unchecked desire takes over a town in the American Midwest.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulsa is a city in the US state of Oklahoma.

clue.text: Bishop takes port and spirit

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port, Rio for short

explanation.surface: A clergyman pours himself a glass of fortified wine and something stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio is vigour or liveliness, the same sense as spirit in a performance.

clue.text: Holiday's affected — pack tents up

parts.note: a break is a holiday
camp means theatrically affected or exaggerated in manner

explanation.surface: A holiday has been disrupted, so the campers pack up.
explanation.definitionFit: To break camp is to dismantle the tents and leave a campsite.

clue.text: It is about half of them on Ecstasy making record

indicators.note: about means the first words surround the next piece

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: half of takes the second half of the following word

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone records half the group taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: To itemise is to list item by item, to record in detail.

clue.text: Regular route undertaken with a bad attitude

parts.note: a round is a regular route, as of a milkman or postman
a burden shouldered is one undertaken or taken on

explanation.surface: Someone resents the daily round they have been given.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attitude' here is bodily posture, not mood: stooped shoulders are a bad attitude of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: Posture is also called attitude, and being stooped at the shoulders is poor posture.

clue.text: Picturesque view, they say, adjacent to Manx prison?

indicators.note: they say signals that a word is heard spoken, not written

parts.note: to see is to view

indicators.note: a Manx cat has no tail, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: nick is British slang for a prison or police station

explanation.surface: A lovely vista sits beside a jail on the Isle of Man.
explanation.walkthrough: SEE spoken matches the opening sound of the answer, spelt SCE. 'Manx' docks the tail of NICK to give NIC. The Isle of Man is a British crown dependency whose cats are tailless.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenic spot is one that is picturesque, pleasing to look at.

clue.text: Boycott start of term — that is formal

parts.note: to black a firm or goods is to boycott them, as a trade union might

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A ban on the opening day of school term, which is official.
explanation.definitionFit: Black tie on an invitation means formal evening dress is required.

clue.text: Cover up offensive remark about a European

indicators.note: about means the first piece surrounds the next

parts.note: an insult is an offensive remark

explanation.surface: Someone tries to hide a rude comment made about a continental.
explanation.definitionFit: To insulate something is to wrap or cover it, for instance against heat loss.

clue.text: Peacekeepers facilitate outbreak of flu — isn't that awkward?

parts.note: UN peacekeepers are United Nations forces
to help is to facilitate

indicators.note: outbreak of means breaking the word up, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Peacekeepers struggle to manage a flu epidemic, which is hardly convenient.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone uncooperative and obstructive is being awkward.

clue.text: Develop extremely elegant heavenly body

parts.note: to plan a scheme is to develop it

indicators.note: extremely picks the two end letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A sculptor shapes a very graceful, divine-looking figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A planet is a celestial body orbiting a star.

clue.text: Airborne troops circling location — they could be hanging on

indicators.note: circling means surrounding the next piece

parts.note: paras are paratroopers
a site is a location

explanation.surface: Parachutists encircle a landing ground, clinging on as they wait.
explanation.definitionFit: Parasites live off a host, hanging on to it for food.

clue.text: Trombones will be played as Queen leaves after time in memorial

indicators.note: played means the letters are worked into a new arrangement, like a tune
leaves means the letter departs from the word

parts.note: R, for Regina, stands for queen

explanation.surface: A brass band plays at a funeral as the monarch departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' drops R from TROMBONES; T for 'time' is added and the whole pool rearranged by 'will be played'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tombstone is a stone monument at a grave, a memorial to the dead.

clue.text: Hesitate with opening key change — the one or the other?

indicators.note: the first letter, itself a musical key, is swapped for a different musical key

parts.note: to dither is to hesitate

explanation.surface: A musician hesitates over which key to start in.
explanation.walkthrough: D and E are both musical keys, so changing the opening key of DITHER from D to E gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Either refers to one or the other of two choices.

clue.text: As an alternative, home brew's brought in shillings and pence

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: brought in says this piece goes inside the letters around it

parts.note: s is the abbreviation for shillings in old British money
d, from Latin denarius, stood for pence in old British money
tea is a brew, especially in Britain

explanation.surface: A homemade beer is paid for in old coins rather than cash.
explanation.walkthrough: Pre-1971 British money was pounds, shillings and pence, written £sd.
explanation.definitionFit: Instead means in place of something else, as an alternative.

clue.text: Angels somehow spare that man

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of the word before it are rearranged in some way

parts.note: him is that man, in the object case

explanation.surface: Someone asks heavenly beings to somehow let him off.
explanation.definitionFit: Seraphim are the highest order of angels in Christian tradition.

clue.text: Crook admires weapon

indicators.note: to crook is to bend, so the letters are twisted into another order

explanation.surface: A criminal is fond of his gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a pistol or other weapon worn at the side.

clue.text: Measure put in place under prince that will raise the standard?

indicators.note: in a down clue placing something under a piece means it comes after

parts.note: Prince Hal is Shakespeare's young Henry V
a yard is a measure of length

explanation.surface: A royal sets a high standard of measurement for others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standard' looks like a benchmark; it is a flag, and a halyard is the rope that hoists it.
explanation.definitionFit: A halyard is a rope used to hoist a flag or sail up a mast.

clue.text: Ideal spot managed without parking and it's remote

indicators.note: managed means handled or worked into a new shape, so the letters are reordered
without says a letter is dropped from the words before

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A perfect place was arranged with nowhere to leave the car, and it's in the middle of nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes P from IDEAL SPOT, leaving IDEALSOT, which 'managed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere isolated is far from others, which is what remote means.

clue.text: Shot this man for overturning symbol of respect

parts.note: a shot of spirits is a tot

indicators.note: overturning in a down clue means the word is read upwards, back to front

parts.note: me is this man, the speaker

explanation.surface: A man is shot for overturning a revered emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an emblem or object treated with reverence by a clan.

clue.text: Needle provoked by feisty lush to a great extent

indicators.note: to a great extent says most of these words supply the answer, which lies within them

explanation.surface: A drunk with a temper is easily stirred up.
explanation.definitionFit: The needle of a record player is called a stylus.

clue.text: Fruit avoided by vegetarians?

parts.note: a large tomato variety is named after a cut of meat, so a meat-avoider might shun it by name alone

explanation.surface: Vegetarians steer clear of a certain fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: Tomatoes are botanically fruit; this big variety only sounds meaty.
explanation.definitionFit: A large variety of tomato, a fruit, whose name includes a cut of beef.

clue.text: Pin-up I would briefly look over

parts.note: I'd is the shortened form of I would

indicators.note: over says the word is turned back to front

parts.note: lo is an old word for look, as in lo and behold

explanation.surface: Someone admits they'd quickly study a poster of a heartthrob.
explanation.definitionFit: A pin-up is a celebrity adored by fans, just as an idol is.

clue.text: Mothers keeping quiet — it's infectious

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within

parts.note: mums are mothers
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Mothers telling a sick child to stay hushed in case they spread germs.
explanation.definitionFit: Mumps is a contagious viral disease that swells the glands.

clue.text: Cutting edge commercials on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio says the word is heard spoken

parts.note: ads are commercials

explanation.surface: Advertisements broadcast on the airwaves are the latest thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutting edge' looks like 'latest'; it is a literal tool with a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: An adze is a woodworking tool with an arched blade, used for cutting.
